title: Beef and Bubble Squeak
description: A classic British dish that combines leftover roasted beef with pan-fried bubble and squeak cakes.
instructions: 1. Slice the beef fillet into thin strips.
2. Heat the light oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add the beef strips to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
4. Meanwhile, shape the bubble and squeak mixture into patties.
5. Add the patties to the pan and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side.
6. Serve the beef and bubble and squeak together, seasoned with zesty salt and pepper to taste.
7. Add water to the pan to create a sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
